title: I-SDPO: Instance-Level Adaptive Self-Distillation Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.12957v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) learns from reward differences within a rollout group, but receives no useful relative signal when every sampled response is incorrect. Privileged self-distillation can fill this gap with dense token supervision, yet applying it throughout training creates a different failure mode: the teacher is a biased, low-variance surrogate for the reward objective, so persistent imitation can oppose reward-improving updates after the policy becomes capable of producing successful trajectories. We introduce I-SDPO (Instance-Level Adaptive Self-Distillation Policy Optimization), which treats teacher reliance as capability-dependent. I-SDPO makes one routing decision per input instance and shares it across that instance's rollout group: all-incorrect groups use a privileged self-distillation objective, whereas any-success groups remain intact for GRPO. translated_title: I-SDPO：实例级自适应自蒸馏策略优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12957v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：组相对策略优化（GRPO）从一组采样结果中的奖励差异中学习，但当每个采样响应都不正确时，它无法获得有用的相对信号。特权自蒸馏可以通过密集的令牌监督来填补这一空白，但在整个训练过程中应用它会产生另一种失败模式：教师模型是奖励目标的偏置且低方差的替代，因此当策略能够生成成功轨迹后，持续的模仿可能阻碍奖励改进的更新。我们引入了I-SDPO（实例级自适应自蒸馏策略优化），它将教师依赖视为能力相关的。I-SDPO对每个输入实例做出一次路由决策，并在该实例的采样组中共享该决策：全错误的组使用特权自蒸馏目标，而有任何成功的组则保留用于GRPO。这种设计仅在组相对奖励信号缺失时使用模仿学习。
tldr: I-SDPO根据每个实例的组内采样结果，自适应用特权自蒸馏或GRPO优化，仅在所有采样均错误时引入模仿学习，避免持续模仿对奖励优化的干扰。
en_tdlr: I-SDPO adaptively uses privileged self-distillation or GRPO per instance based on group outcomes, applying imitation only when all samples fail to avoid hindering reward optimization.
